comparison.objective: Stop an already-moving bottle before it rolls off a worktop; the candidate sets and locks a gripper opening stop.
comparison.physical_skill: Timed interception and gentle arrest of a rolling object, not coaxial driver/wrench counterholding or jam-nut locking.
comparison.success_condition: Bottle remains supported and under 1 cm/s for 1 s without ever crossing an edge; candidate requires a locked 90° setting and three retained actuation cycles.
comparison.reason: Different objective, dynamics, manipulation mechanism, and retained-function test across all six available spec versions.
